title: Define JSON-only gateway finalization
description: Defines durable plan-before-execution records and a single strict JSON terminal result finalized through one gateway command.

requirements.summary: Persist every gateway execution plan before dispatch.
acceptance: AC-001: The normative workflow requires a non-executable inbox/<task_id>.plan.json commit before the matching taskbundle commit.
AC-002: The plan record contains task identity, exact baseline, objective, scope, acceptance criteria, role boundary, and continuation state.
AC-003: GPT owns the principal implementation and the local agent is limited to application, runtime gates, evidence, and narrow repairs.

requirements.summary: Replace duplicate human and machine terminal artifacts with one strict JSON result.
acceptance: AC-004: Future gateway-managed handoffs require only agent-result.json as agent-authored terminal output.
AC-005: Interactive Airelay/Codex text is explicitly non-terminal.
AC-006: succeeded, needs_gpt_revision, and failed all require finalization.
AC-007: The JSON schema forbids unknown properties and conditionally requires successful commit identities and revision next_action.

requirements.summary: Make terminal completion one validated command.
acceptance: AC-008: Every generated executable pack contains TERMINAL_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL.
AC-009: The protocol tells the agent to write agent-result.json and invoke the gateway-generated complete-task command.
AC-010: validate-patch-pack.py rejects missing or incomplete terminal protocol sections.
AC-011: new-patch-pack.sh bundles the dependency-free gateway result validator.

requirements.summary: Provide dependency-free validation and regression coverage.
acceptance: AC-012: validate-gateway-agent-result.py rejects duplicate keys, unknown fields, wrong task IDs, invalid status contracts, and gate mismatches.
AC-013: Native tests cover success, failure, needs-GPT-revision, duplicate keys, unknown fields, missing terminal heading, template content, and plan documentation.

gpt_static_checks_performed: Inspected planner 1.3.0 workflow, reporting, gateway interoperability, patch handoff, pack generator, pack validator, executable handoff template, and managed AGENTS contract.
Separated planner-owned semantic contracts from gateway-owned transport and publication mechanics.
Authored the JSON schema, dependency-free validator, native tests, documentation, and exact source patch.
Committed the coordination plan to rceman/typer before preparing this executable task.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: Patch application against the host repository.
Agent evidence workflow, Git commits, pushes, CI, or gateway publication.
known_integration_risks: This bootstrap task still runs under the deployed legacy dual-output gateway protocol; the new JSON-only protocol applies only after the corresponding gateway implementation is merged and installed.
The current legacy gateway task must be finalized before this taskbundle can execute.
forbidden_deviations: Do not implement gateway runtime mechanics in the planner repository.
Do not remove legacy gateway compatibility from deployed gateway code in this task.
Do not redesign the evidence workflow, change release state, create tags, or broaden beyond the declared files.
Do not delegate principal implementation work back to the local agent.
